jobs.occupation: Part-time Sushi Chef / Kitchen Assistant – Sushi Lovers Ordrup
jobs.description:
Sushi Lovers is looking for part-time sushi chefs and kitchen assistants for our restaurant on Ordrupvej.

We are a Copenhagen-based restaurant group with locations in Torvehallerne, Charlottenlund, Hellerup and Frederiksberg. In Ordrup we serve fresh, high-quality sushi in a busy kitchen where quality and teamwork matter equally.

The job
You will work alongside our kitchen team preparing sushi, handling mise en place and keeping the kitchen running smoothly during service. Shifts start at 15:00, 16:00 or 21:00, and we have shifts available every day of the week. Hours are flexible and planned in dialogue with you, so the job fits well alongside studies or another job.

We are looking for someone who

• 
Has experience from a sushi kitchen or another professional kitchen – or is a fast learner with a genuine interest in sushi

• 
Works cleanly, precisely and with a focus on food safety and hygiene

• 
Keeps a cool head when things get busy and takes responsibility for their own station

• 
Is reliable, shows up on time and is a good colleague

• 
Speaks English or Danish

Experience is an advantage, but attitude and work ethic matter most. We are happy to train the right person.

We offer

• 
Salary according to qualifications and experience

• 
Flexible shift planning via Planday

• 
A young, international and informal team

• 
Staff meals during shifts

• 
Good opportunities for more hours and development within the company

Apply
Send a short application and your CV to service@sushilovers.com. Write "Sushi Chef Ordrup" in the subject line. We review applications on an ongoing basis and hire as soon as we find the right candidates, so don't wait to apply.

jobs.occupation: Seasonal Chef Opportunities in LEGOLAND® Billund, Denmark (Koch/Köchin)
jobs.description:
Seasonal Chef Opportunities in LEGOLAND® Billund, Denmark

Are you an experienced chef looking for an exciting opportunity in Denmark?

LEGOLAND® Billund is one of Denmark’s most iconic destinations, home to the original LEGOLAND® Park and three unique accommodation facilities: Hotel LEGOLAND®, Castle Hotel LEGOLAND®, and LEGOLAND® Village.

We are currently recruiting chefs for the 2026 high season. Every day, we welcome thousands of holiday guests from around the world as well as conference and business visitors. If you enjoy working in a professional, fast-paced kitchen environment and take pride in delivering high-quality food experiences, we would love to hear from you.

What We Offer

• A unique opportunity to work in one of Denmark’s most popular tourist destinations

• A diverse workplace serving both international leisure guests and conference visitors

• A friendly, supportive, and multicultural team environment

• A fixed work schedule with the possibility of additional hours

• Employment under Danish collective agreements, ensuring fair working conditions and security

• Competitive salary: 29000 DKK -31000 DKK per month, depending on qualifications and experience

• Start date: 1 July 2026, or as soon as possible

• Employment until 30 September 2026, with the possibility of extension

• Assistance with practical arrangements, including accommodation, registration, and settling into life in Denmark

We Are Looking For

• Qualified chefs, or candidates with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in a professional kitchen

• Team players who are positive, reliable, and service-oriented

• Individuals who can work independently and take responsibility for their tasks

• Professionals who thrive in a busy, dynamic environment

• Candidates who can communicate in English or Danish

• Applicants who can start no later than 1 July 2026

Work Eligibility

To be eligible for this position, you must have the legal right to work in Denmark. This means you are either:

• A citizen of an EU/EEA country, or

• In possession of a valid Danish residence and work permit

Interested?

Please send us your CV as soon as possible.

For questions about the position, please contact Niels Switzer, Senoir head chef på

niels.switzer@legoland.dk.

If you have any general questions about your stay, please contact People Partner, Marie-Louise

Bredvig, at llb-hrsupport@legoland.dk

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and positions will be filled as soon as we find the right

candidates.

Join us for an exciting summer season in Denmark and become part of a team that creates

memorable experiences for guests from all over the world.

Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI’s global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:

• Technically grounded
• Possess strong leadership and people management skills
• Structured and organized
A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
• Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
• Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
• Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
• Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
• Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI’s automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.
Your next opportunity starts here
We’re looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:

• Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
• Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
• Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
• Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
• Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
• Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
• Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
• Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI’s corporate language
The perks of being at DESMI

• Flexible working hours – including possibilities for remote work.
• Global career prospects – work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
• Skills development and career growth – Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
• Pension – attractive employer contributions
• Private healthcare and life insurance
• On-site canteen – light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
• Company sports & social activities – from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties
What we’re about
But we’re more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:

• A collaborative and supportive team environment.
• Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
• A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
• A company that values sustainability and innovation.
We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive – if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies – the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?
If you're a dedicated and motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

To learn more about this please contact Søren Flummer (SORF@desmi.com). We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Do you want to contribute to protecting energy systems of the future and secure OT infrastructure in Renewable Energy? Then apply to become part of an international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry. PEAK Wind is looking for a Cyber Security Consultant, who wants to take their cyber security career to the next level and is looking to work on a diverse and exciting portfolio within wind power and other renewable Energy sources.

Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable Assets
At PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of Renewable Energy assets and take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and independent power producers among our clients.

Job Content, Responsibilities, and Possibilities:
Based in one of our offices in Denmark (Aarhus and Copenhagen), or Germany (Hamburg) you will be working in a team supporting customer projects and programs within the field of IT/OT and cyber security. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.
- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.
- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.
- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.
- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.

What you Bring and your Qualities
We expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.

As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.

Interested and want to know more?
If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.

PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

PEAK Wind is looking for a Senior SCADA Consultant who can be an integrated part of our SCADA and Cyber Security team, ensuring best-in-class deliverables for our clients, and building a bridge between technical, commercial, and operational OT and SCADA assets.

We take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and Independent Power Producers among our clients.

Solution-driven Senior SCADA Consultant with Technical Network Know-how
Based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, or Zaragoza you will be supporting clients in all aspects of the project lifecycle, from early development to operation.

We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative way of working. SCADA and Cyber Security is a key area for our clients and receives increased attention on both greenfield and brownfield projects. - Negotiating SCADA and Cyber Security requirements in various supply and service contracts on behalf of our clients
- Designing basic network archtiecture and identifying functional requirements from network designes
- Supporting operational teams on OT, SCADA, and Cyber Security investigations and improvements
- Identifying and integrating technical upgrades, new systems, and functionalities
- Managing sub-suppliers for performance management, defining maintenance, and optimizing the reliability

Experienced SCADA Consultant with a holistic mindset:
We are looking for a candidate with knowledge within OT/SCADA systems and Cyber Security. You have broad experience working with SCADA, critical OT or IT systems, across the array of different systems used in production environments. Furthermore, you are familiar and used to working with security standards such as ISO270xx, IEC62443, NERC-CIP, or similar. Knowledge of industrial computer networks is an advantage but not a requirement.

Irrespective of your background, you are solution-oriented and like to find smarter and more efficient ways to solve problems. You are motivated by solving problems and finding solutions that work in the real world and not just on paper. Preferably you have experience in project management or experience from a Supervisor position, which has given you commercial awareness and the ability to work independently. Experience in the wind turbine industry will also be considered an advantage.

The ideal candidate is self-driven, proactive, and has a solution-oriented attitude. You are a good communicator with a proven ability to build sound business relationships and represent them in project meetings and presentations. As PEAK Wind is an international company, you need to have good English communication skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.

The ILL is an international research facility at the forefront of neutron science and technology. Its High-Flux Nuclear Reactor delivers the world's most intense neutron beams to a suite of over 40 scientific instruments. Every year, some 1800 international researchers visit the ILL to carry out cutting-edge experiments across a range of scientific disciplines, driving innovation in the fields of health, energy, the environment and quantum materials. The ILL is also involved in the production of radioisotopes for medical applications. The ILL employs over 500 staff from 25 different countries, in a diversity of careers and a multicultural and inclusive environment.

The Reactor Division is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of ILL's high flux reactor. It oversees reactor operations, fuel management, maintenance, engineering, radiation protection, and technical support. The RDe employs around 100 people, mostly reactor operators and maintenance technicians and nuclear engineers, as well as safety, radiation protection and operations support staff.

We are looking for two mechanical maintenance technicians, who will join the group in charge of radioisotope production and maintenance of the equipment's in the Reactor Division. This group works on all of the reactor's handling facilities, as well as the irradiation processes for medical research.

Your tasks
-    Perform fuel-related handling operations: loading and unloading, replacement of water inside the fuel handling columns. 
-    Maintain the equipment that makes up the reactor's handling facilities: fuel handing columns, handling cranes and gantries, reactor pool gates. 
-    Perform all the operations relating to the production of radioisotope powders: encapsulation of ampoules, loading and unloading of capsules into and from the reactor, internal transport of irradiated capsules, cutting open of capsules in the hot cell, and conditioning of ampoules for shipment to European chemical processing centres. 
-    Operate and maintain the hot cells used to cut up irradiated equipment. 
-    Conduct periodic inspections and requalification of the pressure equipment used by the group (handling column valves, reactor valves, etc.). 
-    Manage maintenance sites from their preparatory phase through to completion of the work. 
-    Draft procedures, technical specifications and reports. 
-    Assist on an occasional basis with the operation of other equipment under the group's responsibility.
-    Maintain the power generators.

Desired profile
-    Level 5/6 qualification (BTEC HNC/HND, foundation degree or equivalent) in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, industrial maintenance or equivalent.
-    First professional experience in industrial maintenance. 
-    Good writing skills for the drafting of procedures, technical specifications and reports. 
-    "Hands-on" approach and a very high level of autonomy. 
-    Strong analytical skills, team spirit, versatility, and the ability to use your initiative. 
-    Practical experience of carrying out maintenance in nuclear installations would be an advantage. 
-    Fluency in French is essential; knowledge of English would be appreciated.

?? Benefits
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Desay SV Automotive Europe GmbH, the European headquarters of Desay SV Automotive, is located in Weimar, Germany. As a technology specialist for advanced hardware, software, and connectivity, we play a key role in transferring Desay SV’s global innovation strength into tailored solutions for the European automotive market. - Mobile working
- Good traffic connections

- Accident insurance (private and professional)

We look forward to receiving your application.

As part of the Certification team , you will be involved with Customer Care Center matters to give the best repair solution to the customers for them to bring back their aircraft in an airworthy condition after an event. 

Your working environment:

Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 

How we care for you:

Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
Work / Life Balance:   Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. 
Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects  with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. 

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.    

 Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. 

Your challenges:

We are in close collaboration with all Airbus design offices worldwide. 

 We are working together with two other off-shore teams, in a follow the sun approach : 
 one based in Mobile (USA) 
 one based in Bangalore (India) 

The work will be performed 7 days a week (monday to sunday) in shifts on day time hours by rotation.

Provide Airworthiness approval of in-service repair solutions supported by the Repair and Design Approval Form (RDAF), and Flight Condition Documents (FCD).  

 Interface with Airbus customer services, design offices, chief engineer teams and the other airworthiness departments.  

 Act on request as airworthiness specialists in a multifunctional team to solve Aircraft on Ground situations (AOG). 

 This position is an opportunity to work for all Airbus civil programs, on all ATA chapters and develop multi-skills. 

 Being part of a very dynamic team, you will acquire a high level of overall aircraft knowledge, and enlarge your network within the company. 

After the initial training period, the work will be performed seven days a week (Monday to Sunday) in shifts on daytime hours by rotation. 

Your boarding pass:

You have an advanced level in English. 

 You are educated to degree level (or equivalent) in Engineering or a related discipline. 

You have structure and systems skills. 

 You have a good general knowledge in aeronautics. 

 You have experience in the design office and/or in airworthiness. Knowledge in configuration management is a plus. 

 You are a real collaborative team player, reactive and curious.

About the position

As part of the global modernization of its infrastructure, our client is migrating its workloads currently hosted on end-of-life physical RKE servers in China to managed services from a Chinese cloud provider. This strategic project, estimated to last 12 months, aims to design a modern, automated, and highly available target architecture.

Contrat : Project-based permanent contract (CDI) or Freelance contract, project with an initial duration of one year (completion scheduled for summer 2027).

Location : Montbéliard area, an on-site presence of at least 2 days/week will be required for the first 2 or 3 weeks during the scoping phase.

Your responsibilities:

Reporting to the IT department's technical team, your responsibilities will be as follows:

Scoping and Estimation: Conduct the technical feasibility study, define the target architecture, and present the detailed estimation to the CIO in September.

Architecture Build: Design and build the infrastructure on a Chinese cloud provider (such as Alibaba Cloud), focusing on managed services.

Automation & Deployment: Replicate the existing automation mechanisms on GCP using Terraform and deploy the new clusters via Helm.

Friction Point Resolution: Design network architectures (SD-WAN, cross-border line) to maintain API connectivity with Google, manage authentication interoperability (Google Identity), and define security policies equivalent to Cloud Armor.

Profile sought

Experience : Proven and mandatory track record on a Chinese cloud provider (ideally Alibaba Cloud). We are looking for a profile with at least 5 years of experience as a Senior Cloud Consultant or Cloud Architect, who has already participated in scoping and estimation phases.

Technical Skills

Mastery of the managed Kubernetes ecosystem, managed databases, and object storage.

Expertise in Terraform and Helm.

Strong skills in international network architecture and cross-border connectivity.

GCP skills.

Knowledge of security solutions (WAF/Cloud Armor) and identity management (SSO/Google Cloud Identity).

Daily use of AI.

Soft Skills :

Analytical mindset and pragmatism to design solutions that are simple to operate daily.

Autonomy and proactive approach to guide the client in their strategic choices (e.g., alternatives to PubSub).

Ability to communicate easily with cross-functional teams.

Languages : Fluent English (international context), French or Mandarin would be a major asset.

Recruitment process :

- Initial interview with our recruiter and the head of the structure, who is an IT engineer.
- Presentation of your application to our client (following mutual agreement).
- Meeting with the client and their teams to discuss the position and expectations.

Would you like to know more? We invite you to apply and/or contact us!

The company
The ILL is an international research facility at the forefront of neutron science and technology. Its High-Flux Nuclear Reactor delivers the world's most intense neutron beams to a suite of over 40 scientific instruments. Every year, some 1800 international researchers visit the ILL to carry out cutting-edge experiments across a range of scientific disciplines, driving innovation in the fields of health, energy, the environment and quantum materials. The ILL is also involved in the production of radioisotopes for medical applications. The ILL employs over 500 staff from 25 different countries, in a diversity of careers and a multicultural and inclusive environment.

The Science Division at ILL brings together close to 200 scientists, engineers, and technicians who work collaboratively to provide users with advanced experimental capabilities and expert scientific support. The DS is responsible by operating world-class neutron scattering instruments, supporting an international user community, conducting cutting-edge research, and developing new experimental techniques. In addition, the division drives the development of next-generation instrumentation and computational tools, fosters international collaborations, and contributes to advanced training.

About the position
As an experiment support and instrument technician, you will be responsible for the operation and development of experimental equipment and for providing support for experiments conducted at the ILL.
You will work closely with the scientists in charge of the instruments you will be assigned to. You will also collaborate with the other technicians in the Spectroscopy group. You will act as technical contact for the instrument WASP within this group. Depending on the needs of the different groups, you may be asked to work in parallel on other instruments within the Spectroscopy group.

Your tasks
Your main duties will involve the following:
-    Performing maintenance work and repairs on instruments and their ancillary equipment
-    Assisting in-house and visiting scientists with the preparation of their experiments
-    Designing new equipment in collaboration with ILL scientists and technical support groups
-    Improving the instruments and the way in which experiments are conducted by devising innovative technical solutions
-    Performing precision machining of simple mechanical parts (lathing, milling, drilling) at short notice
-    Installing, maintaining and operating sample environment equipment (cryostats, furnaces, etc.)
-    Organising the purchase of new equipment and spare parts

Desired profile
-    You have a Level 4/5 qualification (e.g. NVQ, BTEC HNC/HND or equivalent) in mechanical, maintenance or electronic engineering.
-    You have experience in the assembly and alignment of precision mechanical assemblies.
-    You have knowledge of CAD software.
-    Experience in scientific instrumentation, in particular in the field of cryogenics, would be an advantage.
-    You must have a sound knowledge of English and be willing to learn French (a language course will be paid for by the ILL).

Benefits
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities.
